summary: Night bends a flat hand down over the edge of the other arm, like the sun setting below the horizon.
handshape: Bent B hand over a flat arm
movement: Dominant hand drops over the arm
steps: Lay your non-dominant forearm flat in front of you.
Bend your dominant hand at the wrist, fingers pointing down.
Bring it down over the far edge of the other arm.
mistakes: Going under the arm. NIGHT goes over and down; MORNING comes up from under.
